tools.name: about_brokerage
tools.description: What London Foster Realty LLC does, the areas it serves, and what can be booked here.

tools.name: check_area
tools.description: Does London Foster Realty LLC serve this place? Give a city, a county, a ZIP code or an address.

tools.name: open_times
tools.description: Lists the open times for a buyer consultation or a listing appointment with London Foster Realty LLC. Showings are not offered.

tools.name: book_time
tools.description: Books one open time for a buyer consultation or a listing appointment with London Foster Realty LLC. Needs the start of an open time, a first name, a phone or an email, and person_confirmed. Showings are not offered.

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.description: Sends London Foster Realty LLC a request for a buyer consultation or a listing appointment. An agent reaches out to set a time; nothing is booked.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: book_time · Public sink: book_time.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: book_time · Public sink: book_time

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
